video_caption: The video opens with an animated patriotic background featuring blue, red, and white diagonal stripes adorned with white stars. This transitions to display the "LWV LEAGUE OF WOMEN VOTERS OF PORTLAND" logo. Next, a blue background reveals an outline map of Oregon, which then fills with red, accompanied by the word "OREGON" in white text. American flag-themed stars and stripes graphics are positioned on the left side of the screen, followed by a round "VOTE" button and a blue banner with "DEMOCRACY" written in white. The scene then shifts to a red background where a prominent red star with a blue center and white chevron patterns appears on the left. A blue banner emerges from the star, displaying "ELECTION 2020" in white text, with additional white text reading "Video Voters' Guide" and "Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4 Chloe Eudaly." The video then cuts to a man, identified as Chris Cobey from the League of Women Voters of Portland via a lower third graphic, speaking directly to the camera. He has short brown hair and is wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a dark blue polka-dotted tie, seated in an indoor setting with a bookshelf and framed items behind him.

The video begins with a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark, polka-dotted tie, speaking directly into the camera. He is in a room with bookshelves behind him, holding books and framed pictures. At 0:06, the screen splits horizontally, showing the man on the left side continuing to speak, while a woman appears on the right. She has long dark brown hair, wears light purple-framed glasses, a dark top, and a silver chain necklace with a circular pendant, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression, listening. Her background features a white bookshelf filled with books, a small wooden house-shaped decoration, a framed picture, and a green vase with flowers. A blue banner overlays the bottom of the screen with the text "LWW" (logo) "Video Voters' Guide League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org". At 0:15, the screen transitions to a full-screen view of the woman, who now begins to speak, her mouth open and looking at the camera.

The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with long, dark brown hair and bangs, wearing light purple glasses, a black jacket over an olive green shirt, and a silver chain with a pendant. She is speaking directly to the camera with a serious and engaged expression. Behind her is a white bookshelf filled with various books and decorative items, including a wooden house-shaped object, a vase with flowers, and framed pictures. Initially, a text overlay at the bottom of the screen reads: "LWV Chloe Eudaly Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4." Around the 0:03 mark, this text changes to: "Video Voters' Guide League of Women Voters of Portland lwvdpdx.org." The woman continues to speak until 0:47, at which point the screen splits horizontally. The right side retains the woman's frame, while the left side displays a new frame featuring a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark blue tie, also looking directly at the camera.

The video segment opens with a split screen displaying two individuals in a virtual meeting setting. On the left, an older man with short brown hair, dressed in a light blue button-up shirt and a dark tie, sits facing forward with a neutral expression. Behind him is a brightly lit room with shelves and framed pictures. On the right, a woman with long, dark brown hair and light purple-framed glasses is featured. She wears a dark jacket over a green shirt and a silver chain necklace. She is smiling and speaking, looking directly at the camera. Her background consists of a white bookshelf filled with various books, a small wooden house-shaped decorative item containing a light-colored bust, framed artwork, and a green vase holding flowers. As the segment progresses, the camera gradually zooms in on the woman on the right, further highlighting her animated expression as she continues to speak.

The video features a split-screen view of two individuals engaged in a remote conversation. On the left, a middle-aged man with short brown hair, dressed in a light blue collared shirt and a dark blue tie with white polka dots, is speaking with a serious and engaged expression, looking towards the right side of the screen. His background includes light-colored walls, a white door frame, and a shelf or cabinet with framed items. On the right, a woman with long dark hair, bangs, and clear-framed glasses, wearing a dark, possibly olive green, top, is attentively listening, occasionally nodding, and looking towards the man. Her background features a white bookshelf filled with books, a small house-shaped ornament, a vase with flowers, and framed pictures against light-colored walls. A blue banner is displayed at the bottom of the screen throughout the segment, showing "LWV" (League of Women Voters), "Vote411.org" (a voter information website), and "lwvpdx.org" (the website for the League of Women Voters of Portland, Oregon), indicating the context of a civic-focused discussion or interview.

The video opens with a split screen showing two individuals, both appearing to be engaged in a video call. On the left, an older man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark polka-dotted tie, sits in what appears to be an office or study, with framed pictures and shelves visible in the background. On the right, a woman with long dark brown hair and purple-framed glasses, wearing a dark jacket over an olive green shirt and a silver chain necklace, is speaking. She is in front of a white bookshelf filled with books and various decorative items, including a small wooden house with a figure inside, a vase of flowers, and framed art. At the 0:03 mark, the view transitions to a full-screen shot of the woman speaking directly to the camera. At 0:10, a white banner appears at the bottom of the screen with the text "LWV Chloe Eudaly Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4," indicating she is Chloe Eudaly, a candidate for Portland City Commissioner Position 4, and the broadcast is associated with the League of Women Voters. The woman maintains eye contact with the camera and her facial expressions are earnest as she continues to speak until the end of the segment.

In a video segment from 0:00 to 0:02, a woman with long, dark brown hair and bangs is seen speaking directly to the camera. She wears light purple-framed glasses, a dark olive green top, and a silver chain necklace with a circular pendant, maintaining a serious and focused expression. Behind her is a white bookshelf filled with various items including books, a small wooden house decoration containing a bust, a framed black and white picture, a green vase with purple flowers, and another colorful framed picture. A white banner with blue text is displayed at the bottom of the screen, featuring the "LWV" logo on the left and the text "Video Voters' Guide" with "League of Women Voters of Portland lwvdpdx.org" underneath it.

The video opens with a woman, sporting long brown hair and distinct purple-framed glasses, speaking directly to the camera. She wears a dark jacket over an olive-green top and a silver chain necklace with a circular pendant. Behind her, a white bookshelf is filled with various items, including books, a small wooden house containing a bust, a framed spiral artwork, and a vase of flowers. At the 0:03 mark, the screen splits horizontally, introducing a man on the left side, who has short brown hair and is dressed in a light blue button-down shirt and a dark tie with light dots, also looking at the camera. His background features a white wall with shelves holding framed pictures and other objects, along with a visible lamp. Throughout the segment, the woman primarily speaks, appearing serious and focused, occasionally gesturing with her hands which are mostly out of frame. The man listens intently. When the screen is split, a green and black "MetroEast" logo is visible in the bottom right corner. The screen transitions between showing only the woman and the split-screen view, with both individuals maintaining engaged expressions.

In a video call segment, a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt and a dark patterned tie, sits on the left, speaking and looking forward, with a bookshelf visible in his background. On the right, a woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing light purple-framed glasses, a dark top, and a silver chain necklace with a circular pendant, also speaks and looks at the camera, with a white bookshelf filled with books, small sculptures, framed art, and a vase of flowers behind her. From 0:17 to 0:40, the camera zooms in on the woman. A banner at the bottom of the screen displays the "LWV" (League of Women Voters) logo, the text "Video Voters' Guide," and "League of Women Voters of Portland lwvpdX.org." Additionally, from 0:20 to 0:23, a text overlay appears below the woman's image, identifying her as "Chloe Eudaly, Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4." The woman smiles briefly at 0:28 before returning to a neutral expression.

The video displays two individuals on a video call, separated by a black vertical line. On the left, an older man with light skin and short brown hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt and a dark patterned tie, is seated indoors, with bookshelves and framed pictures visible in the background. He is actively speaking, then listening attentively. On the right, a younger woman with light skin and long dark brown hair with bangs, wearing purple-framed glasses, a dark jacket, and a gold pendant necklace, is seated in front of a white bookshelf filled with books, framed art, a small wooden house, and a vase with flowers. She is initially listening, then begins to speak at 0:16, at which point the camera zooms in slightly on her. At 1:06, the camera zooms back out to show both participants. A blue banner is consistently present at the bottom of the screen with a red and white logo that appears to be "LWW" (League of Women Voters), followed by white text that reads "Vote411.org" and "lwvpdx.org", suggesting the context of the video is an electoral discussion or interview hosted by the League of Women Voters.

The video shows a split-screen interview featuring two individuals. On the left is a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a dark tie with white dots, seated in an indoor setting with a bookshelf and framed pictures in the background. His expression is engaged, and he appears to be speaking or asking a question. On the right, a woman with long brown hair, wearing purple-rimmed glasses, a dark top, and a silver chain necklace, is speaking directly to the camera. She sits in front of a white bookshelf filled with books, a small wooden house-shaped decor, a green vase with flowers, and framed pictures. Her expression is serious but hopeful as she discusses making progress in repairing relationships and satisfying settlements. At 00:09, a red and blue banner appears at the bottom of the screen, displaying the text "LWV Chloe Eudaly Candidate Portland City Commissioner Position 4," identifying the woman as a political candidate. As the man on the left begins to speak around 00:25, the woman on the right listens attentively. The banner at the bottom of the screen remains visible, and at 00:27, additional text "Vote411.org lwvppdx.org" is added, providing relevant websites.

The video features a split-screen view of two individuals participating in a virtual discussion. On the left, a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark patterned tie, speaks to the camera, occasionally gesturing with his hands. His background consists of an indoor room with a bookshelf filled with books and decorative items, and a framed picture on the wall. On the right, a woman with long dark brown hair, wearing clear-framed glasses, a black jacket over an olive green top, and a chunky silver necklace, listens to the man's question before beginning to respond. Behind her is a white bookshelf filled with books, a small wooden house-shaped object, a green vase with flowers, and framed artwork. A blue and red banner is displayed at the bottom of the screen with the text "LWW", "Vote411.org", and "lwvpdx.org". The man asks about ideas for securing the financial stability of the park system, and the woman starts her reply. Between 0:00:24 and 0:00:26, a brief green visual artifact appears horizontally across the woman's screen.

The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with long, dark brown hair and bangs, wearing light purple-framed glasses, a green top, and a chunky silver chain with a round pendant. She is speaking directly to the camera, with a serious expression. Behind her is a white bookshelf filled with books, a small wooden house ornament, a framed picture of a spiral, a green vase with flowers, and other decorative items. At 0:00, a blue and white logo "LWV" appears in the bottom left corner. At 0:38, the screen briefly shows a red and white logo "eEast" before transitioning to a split-screen view at 0:39. On the left is a man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and a dark blue patterned tie, sitting in front of a bookshelf. On the right, the woman from the first shot reappears, still in the same setting and attire. A "MetroEast" logo with a stylized green 'M' is visible in the bottom right corner of the split screen.
